environment.description: Same application container image deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB target group has a listener rule on the /api/users/search path that routes through a CloudFront distribution with an origin request policy. The CloudFront distribution has a Lambda@Edge viewer-request function (Node.js 18) that performs URI-decoded query string parameter inspection: any request where a decoded query parameter value contains a single-quote character followed by any SQL keyword (UNION, SELECT, OR, AND, DROP, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, EXEC, --, ;) within 32 characters is rejected with 403. Additionally, the ECS task role has an IAM policy with a condition key restricting the task's outbound network to the VPC endpoint for S3 only (no internet egress), and the SQLite database file is mounted from an EFS volume with encryption at rest using a KMS CMK. The CloudFront distribution also has a response headers policy that strips any error detail from 5xx responses before returning to the client.

config.lambda_edge_function: viewer-request: decodes all query parameter values (URL-decode, double-decode), then regex matches /['][\s\S]{0,32}(UNION|SELECT|OR|AND|DROP|INSERT|UPDATE|DELETE|EXEC|--|;)/i on each decoded value. Returns 403 on match.
config.cloudfront_behavior: Path pattern /api/users/* with Lambda@Edge association on viewer-request event
config.error_handling: CloudFront custom error response: 5xx errors return generic JSON {"error":"Internal error"} with no detail field
config.network_egress: ECS task security group: outbound restricted to VPC CIDR + S3 VPC endpoint prefix list only
config.database: SQLite on EFS with KMS encryption at rest
config.alb_config: Internal ALB, only accepts traffic from CloudFront via custom header validation
